_meta.author: Andrei Sidorenko 5750779
_meta.description: Chief of Police hint lines. Object hints fire when the player is near an interactable object. Room unlock hints will fire when a locked room is unlocked.
_meta.todo: Add hints for remaining rooms (Marcus's home, Lena's apartment, Victor's townhouse, Faculty dining hall) when those rooms are added in Sprint 3.

object_hint.case_file:
This is the document of the case your are working on.
Elena, married women with kids, prominent researcher
 and professor at the city university has been found dead
 in her office at XX:XX pm.
object_hint.computer:
A draft email to a lawyer: 'Regarding financial 
irregularities in Victor Osei's department...'
 She was about to report someone.
object_hint.tweed_thread:
The lamp is smashed. Wait — there's a small thread 
 caught on the broken edge. Looks like tweed.
object_hint.dinner_invitation:
A faculty dinner invitation for last night.
 We should check what time it actually ended.
object_hint.accusation_board: The board's almost empty. We need solid evidence before we can put a name on it. Keep digging.
object_hint.map_board: The case map. Every location and connection we know so far. Useful for tracking who was where.
object_hint.research_paper: Draft paper listing Elena as sole author. Another name's crossed out in red — Lena Voss. She had reason to be angry.
object_hint.keyboard: Security station keyboard. Could pull up the CCTV logs from here — if anyone bothered to keep them running.
object_hint.master_key_log: Only two people have master keys: Dean Osei and the head of security. Victor's key was used at 11:18 PM. That's during the murder window.
object_hint.phone: Phone log: she called Elena at 10:55 PM, no answer. Her neighbour confirms she was on this balcony. Alibi checks out.
object_hint.divorce_agreement: Custody hearing next month. Elena was moving Sophie to Switzerland. Strong motive — but motive isn't proof.
object_hint.laptop: Victor's laptop. The sticky note says 'Password: 1101 0011'. That's binary.
object_hint.jacket: That jacket's tweed. There's a small tear on the left sleeve. The thread from the broken lamp matches — same colour, same weave. He was at the scene.

npc_greeting.marcus: Marcus Hale. Elena's ex-husband. Bitter divorce, custody battle, no alibi for the murder window. Watch how he reacts when you show him things.
npc_greeting.victor: Dean Victor Osei. Composed, charming, claims he was at dinner until 11:30. Watch his hands when you ask the right questions.
npc_greeting.waiter: The waiter cleaning up. He was here all evening — he'd know exactly when the dinner ended.

suspect_reaction.tweed_thread_to_marcus: Two suspects down, both pointing to Victor.
suspect_reaction.tweed_thread_to_lena: Two independent identifications. This thread is Victor's.
suspect_reaction.tweed_thread_to_victor: He didn't deny it's his. And he just touched his left sleeve.
suspect_reaction.master_key_log_to_lena: Lena's keycard couldn't open Elena's office. A master key could.
suspect_reaction.master_key_log_to_victor: He's shutting down. He can't explain the key log. Strongest evidence.
suspect_reaction.computer_to_marcus: Marcus seems unaware. Focus shifts to Victor.
suspect_reaction.computer_to_lena: Lena corroborates. Elena genuinely found something. Victor had every reason to stop her.
suspect_reaction.computer_to_victor: He didn't deny it. Deflected again.
suspect_reaction.case_file_to_marcus: This just has the basic facts. It won't provoke much of a reaction. Try showing something more specific.
suspect_reaction.case_file_to_lena: This just has the basic facts. It won't provoke much of a reaction. Try showing something more specific.
suspect_reaction.case_file_to_victor: This just has the basic facts. It won't provoke much of a reaction. Try showing something more specific.

room_unlocks_hint.victors_house:
Looks like you have unlocked Victors house!
 You can now interrogate him.
room_unlocks_hint.faculty_dining_hall:
Looks like you have unlocked the Faculty Dining hall!
 You might want to interrogate a waiter there.
room_unlocks_hint.lenas_house: Looks like you have unlocked Lena's Apartment! You can now interrogate her.

ending.justice_served: Victor is arrested. Confronted with the thread, the key log, and the dinner lie, he confesses. Elena's family gets closure. Case closed.
ending.suspect_escapes: Not enough evidence. Victor's solicitor blocks the charges. He shreds documents and flies out of the country. The case goes cold.
ending.wrong_accusation: An innocent person arrested. Victor walks free. Six months later, new evidence surfaces — but Victor has disappeared. Injustice.
